original_card.question: Can one precisely specified helper-mixing word satisfy a replacement for the inherited H2/K interface?
methods: Derive a replacement interface lemma and price its implementation.
Seek an exact dirty-input or chronological-cut counterexample to the proposed replacement.
original_card.acceptance_gate: A full boundary contract and paid profile; unchanged scalar counts alone are insufficient. A scoped local result may be retained without a complete supplier. Expanding it into further construction rounds requires the family-level budget and obligation gate in research-family-status.md; an optimistic passing relaxation alone is not acceptance.

allowed_variations: Choose one helper-star or quartet instance; narrow to one boundary implication.

actual_scope: Independently find one exact dirty-helper counterexample to the implication that restoring a helper-star center preserves its literal K source mask, using target 112 and dirty helper basis register 260 in the pinned PR967 R439 word.
scope_change_reason: Open PR #3533 already supplies the abstract three-gate mechanism. This audit narrows to an exact target and dirty basis coefficient in the pinned 661-register R439 candidate, which the PR does not replay.
bottleneck_link: A correct replacement H2/K contract could admit helper-mixing words, but this counterexample shows endpoint restoration alone does not preserve the literal mask. No cost reduction follows without a complete boundary and paid-profile argument.
stop_rule: Stop after the pinned dirty basis coefficient differs between the raw target map and literal K, or if source hashes/indices no longer match. Do not extend to another target or word in this pass.
